verdict.rationale: Exa's own docs say its MCP server is open source and available on GitHub, and the exa-js SDK is published on GitHub. So some first-party source is readable. The core search engine and API service are not shown to be open, and no specific license is named. missing for 10: open-source availability of the core Exa search/index service, a named open license (e.g. MIT/Apache) for the MCP server or SDKs, independent corroboration of the license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Exa MCP is open source and available on GitHub.
